arStrings.szText:
Hitting an enemy with a {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skill reduces their Damage by {c_number}[SF_1 * 100|%1|]{/c}, Slows them by {c_number}[SF_0 * 100|%|]{/c}, and deals {c_random}{dot:POISON_DOT_TOOLTIP}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[SF_2]{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}[SF_3]{/c} times.

All Skills are now also {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skills.
